name: fortnite-zone-lab
description: Fortnite storm research: replay pipeline, statistics API and dashboard.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && node scripts/setup-python.mjs
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn fnlab.main:app --reload --reload-dir api --app-dir api --port 8000
scripts.demo-data: node scripts/py.mjs pipeline/python/make_synthetic.py --preset demo --sample-dt 3 && node scripts/py.mjs pipeline/python/flatten.py --data-dir data_synthetic
scripts.test: node scripts/py.mjs -m pytest api/tests -q && npm --prefix web run typecheck
